t: 南海泡子调查委员会公布调查结果,披露了公司董事和腐败政客中舞弊的细节.
te: The Committee of Inquiry on the South Sea Bubble publishes its findings, revealing details of fraud among company direc…
dz: 南海泡子调查委员会公布调查结果,披露了公司董事和腐败政客中舞弊的细节.
de: The Committee of Inquiry on the South Sea Bubble publishes its findings, revealing details of fraud among company directors and corrupt politicians.

t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫(Johann Sebastian Bach)将六首协奏曲献给勃兰登堡-…
te: Johann Sebastian Bach dedicates six concertos to Margrave Christian Ludwig of Brandenburg-Schwedt, now commonly called …
dz: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫(Johann Sebastian Bach)将六首协奏曲献给勃兰登堡-施惠德特的马格雷夫·克里斯蒂安·路德维希(Margrave Christian Ludwig),现在俗称"勃兰登堡音乐会",BWV 1046–1051.
de: Johann Sebastian Bach dedicates six concertos to Margrave Christian Ludwig of Brandenburg-Schwedt, now commonly called the Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046–1051.

t: 罗伯特·沃尔波尔实际上成为了大不列颠的第一任首相,尽管他本人否认了这个头衔.
te: Robert Walpole becomes, in effect, the first Prime Minister of Great Britain, though he himself denied that title.
dz: 罗伯特·沃尔波尔实际上成为了大不列颠的第一任首相,尽管他本人否认了这个头衔.
de: Robert Walpole becomes, in effect, the first Prime Minister of Great Britain, though he himself denied that title.

t: 一场大地震摧毁了伊朗城市大不里士.
te: A massive earthquake devastates the Iranian city of Tabriz.
dz: 一场大地震摧毁了伊朗城市大不里士.
de: A massive earthquake devastates the Iranian city of Tabriz.

t: 在教皇国,主教米开朗基罗·德·孔蒂被选为教皇,取名"英诺森十三世".
te: In the Papal States, Cardinal Michelangelo dei Conti is elected Pope, and takes the name Innocent XIII.
dz: 在教皇国,主教米开朗基罗·德·孔蒂被选为教皇,取名"英诺森十三世".
de: In the Papal States, Cardinal Michelangelo dei Conti is elected Pope, and takes the name Innocent XIII.

t: 萨法维德·希尔万的沙马希被解职.
te: The city of Shamakhi in Safavid Shirvan is sacked.
dz: 萨法维德·希尔万的沙马希被解职.
de: The city of Shamakhi in Safavid Shirvan is sacked.

t: 瑞典和俄罗斯之间的北方大战争以《尼斯塔德条约》结束。
te: The Great Northern War between Sweden and Russia ends in the Treaty of Nystad.
dz: 瑞典和俄罗斯之间的北方大战争以《尼斯塔德条约》结束。
de: The Great Northern War between Sweden and Russia ends in the Treaty of Nystad.

t: 瑞典在大北方战争中战败后，沙皇彼得一世宣布俄罗斯帝国成立。
te: The Russian Empire is proclaimed by Tsar Peter I after the Swedish defeat in the Great Northern War.
dz: 瑞典在大北方战争中战败后，沙皇彼得一世宣布俄罗斯帝国成立。
de: The Russian Empire is proclaimed by Tsar Peter I after the Swedish defeat in the Great Northern War.
